package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/workercontrol"
)

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	service, err := workercontrol.NewService(ctx, pool, workercontrol.Config{
		LeaseTTL:         2 * time.Minute,
		ActiveLeaseKeyID: "lease-key-v1",
		LeaseKeys: map[string][]byte{
			"lease-key-v1": []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"),
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	workerEpoch, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_EPOCH"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	leaseFence, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("VELA_LEASE_FENCE"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	expectedJobVersion, err := strconv.ParseInt(
		os.Getenv("VELA_EXPECTED_JOB_VERSION"), 10, 64,
	)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	encodedArtifactIDs := strings.Split(os.Getenv("VELA_ARTIFACT_IDS"), ",")
	artifactIDs := make([]uuid.UUID, len(encodedArtifactIDs))
	for index, encoded := range encodedArtifactIDs {
		artifactIDs[index], err = uuid.Parse(encoded)
		if err != nil {
			fatal(err)
		}
	}
	result, err := service.CompleteVisibleCompletion(
		ctx,
		workercontrol.AuthenticatedWorker{ID: uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_ID"))},
		workercontrol.LeaseCredentials{
			AttemptID:   uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_ATTEMPT_ID")),
			WorkerEpoch: workerEpoch,
			Fence:       leaseFence,
			Token:       os.Getenv("VELA_LEASE_TOKEN"),
		},
		workercontrol.VisibleCompletionCandidate{
			CompletionID:       uuid.New(),
			ExpectedJobVersion: expectedJobVersion,
			ArtifactIDs:        artifactIDs,
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		Decision      workercontrol.VisibleCompletionDecision `json:"decision"`
		ArtifactSetID uuid.UUID                               `json:"artifact_set_id"`
		ChargeID      uuid.UUID                               `json:"charge_id"`
		CompletedAt   time.Time                               `json:"completed_at"`
	}{
		Decision:      result.Decision,
		ArtifactSetID: result.ArtifactSetID,
		ChargeID:      result.ChargeID,
		CompletedAt:   result.CompletedAt,
	}); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
